description: 想定し得る最大規模及び計画規模の洪水浸水想定区域図 [flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 宮崎県が管理している河川で、洪水予報河川及び水位周知河川に指定した全35河川について、想定最大規模及び計画規模の降雨を対象とした洪水浸水想定区域のGISデータをダウンロードできます。 (2024年9月掲載データ) 宮崎県が管理している河川について、想定最大規模及び計画規模の降雨を対象とした洪水浸水想定区域のGISデータをダウンロードできま... Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. Its tags are 洪水浸水想定, 防災. It offers 111 resource(s) in docx, zip. The portal shows 2026-06-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
